app.name: CEKBAO
app.synthetic_banner: Demo workspace. Every institution, account and person here is synthetic.
app.footer: CEKBAO compares payment instructions with institution policies. It never moves money and never confirms that a payment arrived.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.lead: Sign in to check a payment instruction against the institution's policy.
signin.failed: That user ID and access code do not match.
signin.expired: Your session ended. Sign in to continue. Your instruction is still on this page and was not saved.
signin.demo_note: Demo access codes are test values listed in policyguard/fixtures/demo_users.json.
check.title: Check payment instructions
check.lead: Paste a payment request you received. We compare it with the payment policy that applies to the institution on your payment date.
check.example_hint: Fills the form with a fictional instruction so you can see how a check works.
check.instruction_hint: Paste the whole message, invoice or web page text. We need the payee name and account number in it.
check.institution_hint: The organisation the payment is for. We only compare with policies published by sources that have authority for it.
check.institution_query_hint: Without a registered institution we cannot compare with a policy, but we will still read the instruction.
check.due_on_hint: Payment policies change. We check the policy that applies on this date.
check.received_on_hint: Helps reviewers see how old the instruction is. It does not change the result.
check.paid_before: I already paid using these details
check.paid_on_hint: We check that payment against the policy that applied on that date, separately from your next payment.
check.upload_hint: PDF, PNG, JPG or TXT, up to {size}. Files are scanned before use. We do not read text from images yet.
check.upload_drop: Drop a file here, or choose one
check.upload_failed: The upload did not finish. Check your connection and try again.
check.corrections_hint: Values you type here replace what we read from the instruction. The result will say they came from you.
check.privacy: Your text is sent to our server and stored with the check. It is not kept in your browser.
errors.title: Fix the following before checking
errors.save_failed: We could not save your check. Nothing was submitted. Your text is still here; try again in a moment.
errors.rate_limited: Too many checks in a short time. Try again in {seconds} seconds. Your text is still here.
errors.form_reused: This form was already used for another check. We kept your changes; select Check instructions again to start a new check.
errors.date: Use a full date, for example 2026-11-15.
errors.due_required: Enter the date you intend to pay.

state.QUEUED.label: Queued
state.QUEUED.description: Your check is saved and waiting to start.
state.PROCESSING.label: Checking

state.COMPLETED.label: Completed
state.FAILED.label: Could not finish

state.DEAD_LETTER.label: Could not finish
state.DEAD_LETTER.description: This is a technical failure, not a judgment about the instruction. Start a new check, or try again later.
state.CANCELLED.label: Cancelled
state.CANCELLED.description: This check was cancelled before it started.
processing.title: Checking your instruction
processing.saved: Saved on {time}. You can leave this page; the check keeps running and this address shows the result.
processing.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Refresh this page later; your check keeps running.
result.title: Check result
result.limitations: What this check does not tell you
result.not_settlement: A policy match does not confirm that a payment is safe or that money arrived.
result.payment_status: Payment status: unknown. CEKBAO does not track payments.
result.read_details: What we read from the instruction
result.source.model: Read by the AI model, quote verified
result.reevaluate: The policy for this institution changed after this check. Run a new check before paying.
evidence.translation: Translation (unofficial, provided by CEKBAO; the original is the authoritative text)
evidence.effective_open: Effective from {from}. End date not published.
evidence.open_source: View policy evidence (opens the source page)
evidence.unauthorized: Source without authority for this institution
evidence.none: We found no policy source to show.
evidence.synthetic_url: Synthetic address; not a real website
level.PUBLIC_SOURCE.description: Published on a public page. Not confirmed through the institution's registry.
level.INSTITUTION_ATTESTED.description: The publisher is registered as allowed to set payment details for this institution.
level.OFFICIAL_TRANSACTION.description: Comes from an authorized payment system.
level.NONE.description: We had nothing that could support a comparison.
next.PAY_ONLY_THROUGH_OFFICIAL_CHANNEL: If you pay, use only the details and payment method in the institution's policy. This check does not confirm that the payment is safe or that it will arrive.
next.DO_NOT_PAY_CONTACT_INSTITUTION: Do not pay using these details. Contact {institution} through its official contact page and ask them to confirm the payment details.
next.REQUEST_INSTITUTION_CONFIRMATION: Do not rely on this instruction yet. Ask {institution} to confirm the payment details through its official contact page.
next.WAIT_FOR_INSTITUTION_REVIEW: Wait before paying. This check is in the institution reviewer queue; you can also ask {institution} which details are correct.
next.PROVIDE_PAYMENT_DATE: Add the date you intend to pay and check again.
reason.ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: The account in the instruction ({found}) is not the account in the policy ({expected}).
reason.PAYEE_MISMATCH: The instruction names {found} as the payee. The policy names {expected}.
reason.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The instruction asks for {found}. The policy accepts {expected}.
reason.SWIFT_MISMATCH: The bank code (SWIFT/BIC) {found} is not the policy's code {expected}.
reason.CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED: The instruction asks for payment by {found}. The policy allows: {expected}.
reason.MATCHES_SUPERSEDED_POLICY: {found} was the account in an earlier policy version. It is no longer valid on this date; the current account is {expected}.
reason.SOURCE_CONFLICT: Two sources with authority for this institution give different account numbers. We do not pick one; the institution has to confirm which is correct.
reason.UNKNOWN_INSTITUTION: We could not identify the institution, so there is no policy to compare with.
reason.NO_POLICY_FOUND: We have no payment policy on record for this institution.
reason.ISSUER_NOT_AUTHORIZED: The only policy source we found is published by someone who is not registered as allowed to set payment details for this institution.
reason.NO_POLICY_AT_DATE: No approved policy version applies on this date.
reason.VALIDITY_UNKNOWN: The policy source does not say from when it applies, so we cannot match it to your date.
reason.DATE_UNKNOWN: We need the date you intend to pay, because payment policies change over time.
reason.CLAIM_INCOMPLETE: We could not find an account number in the instruction.
reason.SOURCE_STALE: The policy source was not re-checked by its scheduled date.
reason.PROMPT_INJECTION_DETECTED: The instruction contains text that tries to give orders to automated systems. Treat that as a warning sign.
reason.ALL_FIELDS_MATCH: The payee, account, currency and bank code in the instruction match the policy.
limitation.NOT_A_SETTLEMENT_CHECK: This check compares the instruction with a policy. It does not show whether a payment was made, received or is safe.
limitation.HISTORICAL_ONLY: This matches the policy that applied on that earlier date. It does not approve future payments to the same details.
limitation.END_DATE_UNKNOWN: The policy source does not say when it ends. We used it because it is the approved version for your date.
limitation.PAID_INFERENCE_DISABLED: The AI model was not used for this check, because no inference budget is approved. The instruction was read with fixed rules.
limitation.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The AI model was unavailable, so the instruction was read with fixed rules.
limitation.MODEL_OUTPUT_REJECTED: The AI model's answer failed validation and was discarded. The instruction was read with fixed rules.
limitation.FIELD_NOT_GROUNDED: Some details proposed by the AI model were not found word for word in the instruction, so we ignored them.
limitation.SYNTHETIC_DATA: This demo uses synthetic institutions, sources and accounts.
